mentions.name: Structo
mentions.description: A writing app for working at a higher level of abstraction with "ideas" (small paragraphs) that can be moved around to restructure many or whole paragraphs by changing just a few words. The final text is generated by an LLM that has the whole context, so it can answer questions about the writing and, more importantly, provide feedback.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A writing app.

The overall idea is to work/write at an higher level of abstraction where you work with "ideas" (just small paragraphs).

You can move them around and basically restructure many/whole paragraphs by simply changing few words.

The final text is generated by an LLM.

LLM that has the whole context so you can ask it questions, but more importantly it can provide you feedback
mentions.author: iot_devs
